Banner Headline: Learn about clinical trials that may help vitiligo treatments
Study Information:
Living with vitiligo can be challenging, but staying informed can help you take control of your health.
Consider learning about vitiligo clinical trials that are actively enrolling by joining WeConnect, an online registry offering access to health information, peer support, and updates on clinical trials that may be right for you.
If you struggle with vitiligo and are 18 years of age or older, you may be matched to an active clinical trial.
Participation is voluntary and confidential, and there is no obligation to enroll in a clinical trial. The registry simply helps connect you to trials that may be relevant to your condition.
